picks.name: AIRism Cotton Crew Neck T-Shirt, olive
picks.why: There's still no plain tee in the wardrobe, and it holds up the office, date-night and everyday outfits. A regular-fit, standard-length crew with a smooth cotton face and no branding, so it sits flat under a knit or overshirt. Olive goes tonal under the Ashby, or with the 502s and Sambas.

picks.name: 100% Merino V Neck Cardigan, navy
picks.why: The office and date-night outfits still have no knit or cardigan, and winter is the time for one. A fine-gauge merino cardigan in a regular, hip-length cut with a ribbed hem that sits flat, plain buttons and no logo. Wear it over a tee with the fawn chinos and brown Docs for work, or the 502s for a date.

picks.name: Warm Pile Lined Joggers, navy
picks.why: The lounging outfit has no joggers yet. These are a regular, tapered cut with stretch, ribbed cuffs and a soft pile lining for cold evenings, with nothing baggy or branded. Pair them with the navy or grey marl raglan sweat for a tonal look at home.
